The '''Central Civic area''' was located in the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. It connected to the [[Council Hall bubble]], which contained the [[High Board Room/Legends|High Tower Boardroom]], the gathering place of the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]].
